instruction: School Space Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 6 spaces and 6 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Classroom-1, Classroom-2, Corridor, Restroom, Office and Janitor. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 41 total OS:Surface objects, split into 6 floor surfaces, 6 roof/ceiling surfaces and 29 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 6 Ground, 19 Outdoors and 16 Surface. Do not add any subsurfaces or windows. Do not include ideal-loads air systems. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 6 zone HVAC equipment lists. Do not include dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 20.00 m in X, 9.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 164.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 185.60 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
